glossary.definition: As used in this section, "lacks the capacity to consent" means being impaired for any reason to the extent that the person lacks sufficient understanding or capacity to make and carry out reasonable decisions concerning the person or the person's resources.
glossary.source_title: Section 2913.73 - Evidence that victim lacked capacity to give consent.
